info.title: Decision Tables
info.description: Named decision tables any app can author and any flow step can use by reference. A table stored here is read by DecisionTableStore and evaluated by DecisionTableEvaluator; the flow step `openregister.decision-table` takes either an inline table or a `tableRef` naming one of these by key or uuid. RBAC-scoped and auditable through OpenRegister's object infrastructure (ADR-022) rather than a bespoke table.

x-openregister.description: Foundational decision-table register shipped by OpenRegister so a table is authored once and used by every flow and app that needs it (decision 186).

decision-tables.title: Decision Tables
decision-tables.description: One row per named decision table.

decision-table.x-openregister-demo-data: Decision tables are the rules an administrator or an app ships, not sample content: a generated table would be evaluated by real flows.
decision-table.title: Decision Table
decision-table.summary: A table of rules that recommends an outcome from its inputs.
decision-table.description: A DMN-style decision table: a hit policy, input and output columns, and rules whose cells are unary tests. Saving refuses a table the evaluator cannot execute, with the same validator the inline flow step uses. A flow step references a table by its key, so the table can be corrected in one place.

key.description: Stable reference a flow step or an app uses for this table, for example `enforcement-intervention`. Unique within the register.
key.title: Key

name.description: Name shown to the people who author and read the table.
name.title: Name

description.description: What the table decides and where its rules come from.
description.title: Description

hitPolicy.description: How the matching rules become one answer.
hitPolicy.title: Hit policy

inputs.description: Input columns, each with a `name` and an optional `type`.
inputs.title: Inputs

outputs.description: Output columns, each with a `name` and, for PRIORITY, an ordered `values` list.
outputs.title: Outputs

rules.description: Rules, each with an `id`, `inputEntries` (one unary test per input) and `outputEntries` (one value per output).
rules.title: Rules

owner.description: App that ships or owns this table, for example `dossiq`. Empty for a table an administrator authored.
owner.title: Owner
